answer: Builder's take: triangulate every ID by network latency. Each epoch, 5 verifier nodes on separate continents ping the ID with a cipher-signed nonce, and the 5 round-trip times form its fingerprint. A clone farm on one box glints like a reef of identical opal: same RTT vector within 3 ms, so those IDs get pooled into one reward share. Proposed: 3 ms match, 24 epochs of history. Measured: nothing yet; false merges in shared datacenters must be tested first.
